attempts.question_asked: Tell me about a time a schedule changed at the last minute.
attempts.response: Two instructors were out. I called people, moved rooms and updated a sheet.

assessment.rationale: Activity does not establish agreement about the revised owner and room.

attempts.question_asked: Make your personal confirmation step explicit. What did you check, and what did the team achieve?
attempts.response: My manager prioritized the registered groups. I kept one change log and asked each owner to confirm the revised room. I checked the three sessions ran; the manager and instructors also did the work.

assessment.observation: asked each owner to confirm the revised room
assessment.rationale: The confirmation step is explicit under a cue and ownership is bounded.

attempts.question_asked: The room owner says the change was never agreed, but your sheet says it was. What would you do next?
attempts.response: I would compare the last confirmed message with the sheet and ask the room owner to verify the current constraint. Before promising the room, I would record the agreed owner and time and send the corrected plan for confirmation.

assessment.observation: send the corrected plan for confirmation
assessment.rationale: The proposed method tests the same confirmation behavior in a new fictional situation.

drills.intervention: Ask which agreement the candidate personally confirmed, not just which messages they sent.
drills.success_cue: Response explicitly states the affected owner confirmed the revised room.
drills.comparison: ATT-001 edits a sheet; ATT-002 asks each owner to confirm. This is a fictional coached contrast; ATT-003 remains a separate illustrative variant.

readiness.remaining_gaps: No actual user practice; Q-002/Q-003 unpracticed; appointment logistics unknown.
readiness.next_action: Ask the actual candidate the neutral booking-conflict question without the cue or model answer.
